description: [PRO] Performs numerical technical calculations for construction trades with code-compliant results. Use this tool when a specific measurement, size, rating, or capacity needs to be calculated — not just checked for compliance. Returns the calculated value with units, the method or formula used, relevant derating or correction factors, and the code reference that governs the calculation. Supports: cable/conductor sizing (mm2 or AWG), voltage drop (%), pipe sizing (mm or inches), HVAC duct sizing (CFM/L/s), heat load calculations, load current calculations, and more. Example inputs: 'Cable size for 32A circuit, 25m run, 240V single phase, clipped direct', 'Pipe size for 40 fixture units copper hot water supply', 'Duct size for 1200 CFM round duct'.

api_key.description: Pro API key required. Get at https://rickyfarmer.gumroad.com/l/Legis-LinkPro

calculation.description: Describe the calculation needed with all relevant parameters. Include: load/flow value, distance/length, voltage/pressure, installation method, ambient conditions. Example: 'Cable size for 45A, 30m run, 240V, single phase, in conduit, 35 degrees ambient'.

region.description: Use the state, province or country where the user works; if they have not said, ask them - never assume NSW or Australia. Jurisdiction. Affects which standard and units apply (e.g. mm2 for AU/UK, AWG for USA).

role.description: User role. Affects detail level of the output.

trade.description: The trade for this calculation. Determines the applicable standard and units.

name: calculate_technical_spec
title: Calculate a technical spec (Pro)
